T.title: Listen to Every Neighbor
T.p1: Tap each neighbor to hear what they hope and what they worry about.
T.p2: Find two neighbors who want the same thing. Read each hope and each worry: a worry shows what someone wants, too. Tap one neighbor, then another.
T.picked: Picked. Now tap one more neighbor.
T.noplan: These two don't share one of the 4 wishes here. Do you see something else they share? Talk about it with someone. Then try another pair.
T.all: And one wish everyone shares: to be heard.
T.p3: Tap the neighbor who said it.
T.can: I can listen to every neighbor before I make up my mind.
T.tipPairs: Next time, read each neighbor's hope and worry before you tap.
T.tipWish: Next time, try more pairs. Most neighbors share something.
T.tipLine: Next time, read each hope and worry slowly.
T.tip100: Great listening! Try a new round.
T.real: Ask someone at home: 'What do you hope for our neighborhood?' Listen to the whole answer.
